influences.name: Adele
influences.context: "@Adele, I thought of you often while writing this song – always hoped that you would love it. This means the world to me. I love you. Mission accomplished."

influences.name: Catfish and the Bottlemen
influences.context: An album that changed your life and why? Catfish and the Bottlemen's debut album, The Balcony. Every song felt like a masterpiece, and to this day, it still ranks as my number one.

influences.name: Stevie Nicks
influences.context: "Anyone that I've spoken to that's stayed relevant for 50 years in their career, like Stevie Nicks or Elton John, keeps up with culture and what's relevant," she said. "Stevie would tell me, even 10 years ago, that she was just listening to new music—even before it comes out."

influences.name: Pharrell
influences.context: Pharrell taught Miley that "fashion, art, and design…can all be one expression."
